id: D56-0 gate: the electron-pressure profile on the table's own bins, in the paired cross-fitted corrector of D50
author: first_agent
reason: the second agent (handover 2026-10-13T155939Z) measured on 64 training shots that the product of the binned T_e and n_e means differs from the binned mean of the channel products by 0.235 % pressure-weighted (over 1 % in 17 % of bin observations), and proposes 42 columns (18 bin means of the product, 18 joint flags, 6 summaries) for a pressure-augmented network family. D50 tested chord integrals of the product (74 columns) and found nothing (+1.1e-6, P .55); it did not test the profile on bins. A network family costs GPU-hours and both cohorts are reused, so the cheaper discriminating test comes first.

arms.control: 13 out-of-fold S16 heads + plasma current, toroidal-field current, their ratio, 1/current (identical to D50's control)

data_corrector_measure: exactly D50 (protocol d67ec5f9): nn_oof.npz 23f6d850, run_d50_gate.py, d50_paired.py, d9_gate_eval.py unchanged; 12 threads instead of 22 (another job of the first agent is running)
rule: PASS if paired dS_proxy >= +1.5e-5 with P >= .95 and positive in at least four folds -> the pressure-augmented network arm is designed and frozen (matched zero-feature control, same width, seeds and member count, against the whole deployed baseline). FAIL -> the bin profile of the product carries nothing the heads lack either; the network arm is not run.
known_limits: As in D50: the heads are the 16-network table ensemble of 5 Oct, and a corrector is not a network. A failure does not exclude every neural formulation; it removes the measured reason for building one.
exposure: Smoke test of the extractor on the first 20 training shots (inputs only; zero shares printed). D50's result on the same heads and folds is known.
rule_3: DIII-D training data only; inputs only for the features.
